title: An owner who is already set up reads as set up: their checklist ticks what they have, and Create a Space opens their Space, not Spotlight setup

source.ref: Owner report 2026-11-19 (project thread: Fix the Create a Space link and onboarding)

detail:
Owner report 2026-11-19: signed in, the Create a Space link on his own Spotlight opened the console's Spotlight tab, and his setup checklist did not show his Spotlight, Space and website as done. Two causes. (1) His launch row was started 2026-11-04 and never had a Space attached, so every reader took it for a launch on step one: the Finish setup list (lib/launch/get-started-io.ts) returned nothing and the header pill counted 0 of 9. One active launch was in this state in production. (2) /create-a-space and /launch/start sent every owner of one Space to /spaces/<slug>/manage/spotlight, which is right while the Spotlight is not live and a dead end once it is.

DONE 2026-11-19: a running launch with no Space takes the person's one Space (lib/launch/space-choice.ts adoptableSpace, written by lib/launch/adopt-io.ts with the same two writes the 'Which Space is this for?' button makes); two or more Spaces stay the person's choice and a builder making a new Space is left alone. An owner whose Spotlight is live lands on /spaces/<slug>/manage from the Create a Space door; one whose Spotlight is not live still lands on its setup. A signed-out visitor is unchanged: /create-a-space opens the no-account builder. Items no record backs (a Circle, a Journey, a campaign) stay on the list. Not changed here: 'Say what you do, in your words' still reads only the launch form's own line, so a Spotlight arranged in the editor leaves it asking; lib/launch/get-started.test.ts pins that, and changing a pin is the owner's call.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
